title: Ful Medames
description: Ful Medames is a Egypt classic prepared with fava beans, garlic, lemon juice, parsley. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used. Start from dried fava beans, soaked and thoroughly cooked, rather than ready-cooked ful beans.

steps.instruction: Soak the dried beans or peas in plentiful cold water for 480 minutes, then drain and discard the soaking liquid; keep refrigerated in hot conditions.
Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 70 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Mash some of the fully cooked fava beans with a little hot water, then fold in garlic, lemon, cumin and olive oil; keep a rustic texture.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
